Examined all supplied units, including file metadata and BASE/HEAD comparisons. SandboxEligibility.swift:225-226,308-309 now includes planned slots and images when reporting disk needed for another job; :271-277 adds explanatory output. These changes do not alter the visible eligibility gates or fallback allocation loop, execute commands, expose credentials, or change serving authorization. No concrete security regression is established in this source scope.

sandboxes.md:85-94,120-125 documents replanning an installed add-on, additive-only unattended changes, and refusal during running jobs without --force. Relevant contracts are A-018/A-019, TB-012/TB-013 and T-059/T-061: additional installer execution remains owner-account execution, and slot changes must preserve inference exclusion and running-job earnings. Existing installer trust risk is not a new finding. The cli-reference.md:2380-2553 excerpt is outside its changed ranges; its runtime and cluster descriptions provide no evidence of a new authorization, encryption or attestation change (TB-002/TB-011).

Integration must inspect SandboxSetupCommand.swift's new reportAndRecheckSizing path (patch-visible head :143), confirmation/unattended decisions and installer arguments; only metadata and a bounded orientation patch were supplied here. Verify that a job starting after the status check is refused atomically by the installer, that --force is never forwarded, and that downloaded plan fields are bounded before the new Int64 multiplication/addition. These are unverified contracts, not observed missing controls. The installer implementation and plan decoder are not supplied in this batch; documentation alone cannot establish those protections.
